subject: Crescent Bank: MAP proposal and security gate timeline
messages:
From: Elaine Brooks <elaine@crescentbank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Info & timing for MAP / SOC 2 / DPA questions

Connor —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Crescent Bank is moving this evaluation forward and procurement asked me to lock down a short mutual action plan so we can coordinate security gates (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ rows, DPA and retention windows) with our internal compliance calendar. High level asks from our side:

- Can you provide a concise MAP with milestone dates we can show execs?
- We need a SOC 2 report + an index of evidence artifacts (what you can share).
- SIG/CAIQ: mapping to rows that are not-attestation (data residency, encryption, key management) — a simple CSV is fine.
- DPA draft and proposed data retention defaults (we typically require 7-year retention opt-in for some records; need clarity on log retention).

Target: procurement wants a go/no-go decision by Jan 31 — is that feasible? If not, what’s the compressed path?

Appreciate it —
Elaine Brooks
Director, Vendor Risk
Crescent Bank

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Info & timing for MAP / SOC 2 / DPA questions

Team — forwarding Crescent's asks. Procurement wants a MAP they can share with execs and a compressed path to a Jan 31 decision. Key asks: SOC 2 artifacts index, SIG/CAIQ row mapping (data residency & KMS bits), DPA draft + retention defaults.

Proposal (very compressed):
1) Today (Jan 11): we draft a 1-page MAP + SOC2 evidence index.
2) Jan 12–13: security review (Laura) + SIG mapping (Ben).
3) Jan 15: send MAP + DPA draft to Crescent for initial review.
4) Jan 22: evidence handoff (secure link), follow-up Q&A session.
5) Jan 29–31: procurement decision window.

Specific asks: Laura — can you confirm what evidence we can share publicly vs. under NDA (PDF index vs. raw artifacts)? Ben — can you prepare a one-sheet mapping of the SIG/CAIQ rows Crescent flagged (focus on encryption, key mgmt, data residency, incident response)? Marcus — please confirm default retention windows we can propose and any carveouts for logs.

I'll own the MAP doc and outreach. If this timeline is tight we should flag any hard blockers now.

Thanks,
Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Jan 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Info & timing for MAP / SOC 2 / DPA questions

Connor —

We can meet their Jan 31 window but it will be tight; here's what I can commit to immediately:

- SOC 2: provide latest Type II report (redacted where needed) and a 2-page evidence index (what the report covers, link to whiteboard notes for controls we cannot share). Delivery: Jan 15.
- SIG/CAIQ: Ben will map the 12 rows they called out into a simple CSV with our control references and whether the evidence is public / NDA-only / not-applicable. Delivery: Jan 14.
- DPA & retention: Marcus + Legal will prepare a DPA draft with default retention table (tokens/logs/metrics):
  - Model logs (inference traces): 90 days default, option for 7 years on request (commercial add-on + audit).
  - Billing/audit records: 7 years.
  - Prompts & outputs: default 30 days (configurable); can provide options for shorter retention or on-prem enclaves.
  Delivery: Jan 15 (DPA draft), retention table in the MAP.

Blockers: if Crescent requires SOC 2 raw artifacts (hosted evidence files) we need an NDA and secure transfer. Otherwise the index + redacted report is standard. If procurement insists on a 7-year default for inference traces without add-on we should price that separately; I'll loop Legal.

Ben — please call out KMS provider (customer-managed keys via our KMS integration is allowed in Private deployments) and note which SIG rows rely on CMEK vs. platform-managed keys.

I'll review Connor's MAP draft and tighten the timeline language.

Laura Bennett
Head, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Brooks <elaine@crescentbank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@crescentbank.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2028 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Crescent Bank condensed evaluation & security gate plan (v1)

Elaine —

Thanks again. Attached is a compact Mutual Action Plan that aligns to the Jan 31 decision window and includes the security/compliance gate checklist we discussed. Highlights:

- Milestones and owners (dates aligned to Crescent procurement window).
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and a 1-page evidence index attached.
- SIG/CAIQ mapping for priority rows (encryption, KMS, residency) — summary included, full CSV to follow.
- DPA draft with retention defaults (model logs 90d default; billing 7y; prompts/outputs 30d default), with options called out for 7y inference trace retention as paid add-on.

Next steps we propose: review + annotate the MAP by Jan 18; evidence handoff on Jan 22 (secure link); final procurement window Jan 29–31. If you want a call to walk execs through the MAP I can schedule a 30-min slot — available Jan 16 or Jan 19 morning PST.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: crescentbank_map_v1.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)]
- [Attachment: soc2-evidence-index.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Brooks <elaine@crescentbank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@crescentbank.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Jan 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Crescent Bank condensed evaluation & security gate plan (v1)

Connor / Laura —

This is really helpful, thank you. Procurement sees the MAP as sufficient to brief execs. Two quick follow-ups:

1) Could you add a one-line entry in the MAP that confirms we can request CMEK for private deployment pilots? That will unblock our security team.
2) For the 7-year inference trace option, can you provide a short note on how audit access is handled (who at Crescent gets access, how is access logged)?

If those two items are in the v1.1 MAP we can move to internal sign-off and aim at the Jan 31 decision. I'd take the Jan 16 walkthrough if you can make that slot.

Elaine Brooks
Director, Vendor Risk | Crescent Bank
[Elaine mobile: +1-415-555-0194]
